# dsh-usage-replay
中文 | English
Cross-session **per-model token usage** for DeepSeek Harness: a usage panel tab, a per-conversation
per-model popover, and two local read-only HTTP routes. Every number is replayed from the harness's
own persisted session logs — nothing is accounted in a side channel, so uninstalling never loses dat
a and history predating this plugin counts too.
**Tokens only.** No cost estimates, no price tables, no network calls.
## What you get
**Usage panel tab** (needs dsh-better-sidebar ≥ 0.28): register a `用量 / Usage` tab in the right side
age panel tab** (needs dsh-better-sidebar ≥ 0.28): register a `用量 / Usage` tab in the right sidebar.
- **Models** — per provider/model: sessions, requests, uncached input, output, cache read, cache wri

te, total.
- **By day** — last 30 days. Toggle **stacked bars ⇄ per-model smooth curves**; hover for
an immediate tooltip (date · day total · per-model rows). The curve view y-scales to the largest si
ngle-model day so the highest line reaches the plot top. **Log-scale** toggle for long-tail data (a

single huge day otherwise flattens everything else). Bars stack by real token share.
- **Workspaces*
* — usage ranked by session `cwd`, with each workspace's model mix.
**Composer-dock pill** — a neutral `分模型 / Per-model` chip next to the native activity/usage pills; c
lick to open this conversation's per-model table (model / requests / input / output / cache read / c
ache write / total). No duplicated totals in the dock row.
## Optional: session-scoped changed files
The native changed-files card summarizes each turn from git working-tree snapshots, so in a workspac
e shared by several sessions (or edited by a running watcher) it can list files this conversation ne
ver touched. Enabling `sessionScopedEdits: true` narrows that card to the files this conversation's
file tools actually touched in the turn:
- Tracks `fs/write-intent` / `fs/edit-intent` per session and turn (the same events the recorder its
elf uses) and filters the `workspaceChanges` service summary in place, remapping per-file diff index
es so the card UI keeps working unchanged. Reversible on unload; turns the plugin did not observe fa

ll back to the native summary.
- Subagent file-tool edits count for the parent conversation's turn.
- Trade-off: files changed **only** through shell commands are not attributed and stay hidden while
changed **only** through shell commands are not attributed and stay hidden while this option is on.
Off by default (it changes another plugin's observable behavior). Enable it in the plugin row config

## How it measures
- Walks `$DSH_HOME/sessions` (default `~/.dsh/sessions`) for `session[.vN].jsonl[.zstd]` artifacts,
decodes the multi-frame Zstandard container frame by frame (torn tail tolerated), and folds `assista

nt/message` usage events into the provider/model of the most recent `request/header` envelope.
- App
lies to the whole session log (not the visible/compacted window), so pruned or compacted turns still

count.
- Results cached per file by `size + mtime`; unchanged files are never re-read.
- Retries/at
tempts count where the provider reported usage — the same billing-shaped semantics as the official t
t where the provider reported usage — the same billing-shaped semantics as the official token meter.
## Privacy

- Reads local session logs only. **No network requests, no telemetry, no uploads.**
- Routes: `GET /
usage-replay/api/summary`, `GET /usage-replay/api/session?sessionId=…` — loopback/trusted-host admis
sion through the host's Connection service, same fence as every other plugin route. Nothing sensitiv

e is returned beyond per-model token numbers.
- The plugin adds no model-visible prompt, tool, or sc

returned beyond per-model token numbers.
- The plugin adds no model-visible prompt, tool, or schema.
## Install
Requires **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1+** (uses the 0.2.1 Connection service).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Desktop app profiles are managed by the app: install from its **Plugins** page with the package path
/spec instead of the CLI. A new host half needs an app restart; client-only updates apply after a ha
ad of the CLI. A new host half needs an app restart; client-only updates apply after a hard refresh.
`dsh-better-sidebar` is an optional peer: without it the sidebar tab is not registered and the compo
ser-dock pill still works.
## Develop
No dependencies, no build step. Node 22.19+ / 24 (host runtime) is enough.
